name: Gemma 4 31B-it
description: Google DeepMind's 31.3B dense vision-language decoder: 60 layers in a [5 × sliding-window (1024), 1 × full] pattern, GQA 32/16 × 256 on sliding layers and 32/4 × 512 with K = V on full layers, GeGLU 21,504, sandwich RMSNorms, a tied 262K-vocab head with logit softcap 30, and a 27-layer ViT (576M) for images and video frames; the 470M MTP drafter ships separately as gemma-4-31B-it-assistant. Traced from the transformers gemma4 / gemma4_assistant code and checked against checkpoint tensor shapes.

summary.note: Every tensor in the checkpoint (incl. MTP / draft and vision weights), summed from the safetensors headers. The 0.47B MTP drafter ships in a separate repo (google/gemma-4-31B-it-assistant) and is not included.

Weights multiplied per text token by the main model: lm head included; embedding (a row lookup), MTP / draft heads and vision / audio encoders excluded. The lm head is tied to the embedding, so the same 1.41B table counts here as the head.

summary.value: SWA-1024 5 : 1 full, GQA 32 q / 16 kv (sliding) · 32 q / 4 kv, K = V (full)
